name: Voxel World 3D
description: Low-poly voxel 3D: a blocky island of grass and dirt cubes with voxel trees and clouds over water, sharp-edged block objects, a warm low sun with a single shadow, light haze and a slow orbit. Game-like, friendly and bright. No emoji.
prompt_hint: 6-10 scenes (3-5 s). Each: title.kicker + title.main, visual.type "scene3d" with 1-4 objects: character (anim walk/yes/no/pick-up), house, tree, cube, coin (value = stack), folder, chart, rocket. flow + connect for a process. No emoji.
